__comment: 4x4x16 substation pole post textured to match Electroenergetics' concrete pole. Self-contained: references EE's 32x32 concrete_pole texture directly (#0). The 4px-wide post face samples a 4px-wide (2 uv-unit) column of EE's clean repeatable body band (v 8-16, the lower half of the strip) so it isn't horizontally squished and has no dark base line or bright top edge, plus a matching 4px cap region. The datagen-supplied #side/#end (kept clean for the BER link nubs) are left unused here. Parents block/block for the 3D item icon. Used with axisBlock rotation.
